title: Ontology metamodel
description: The metamodel (M2) of Naive's ontology (N-048, EE-113). docs/ontology.json follows the ontology class, and a model may only propose a change to it as a change line that validates against $defs/change_line (python3 schema/validate.py --schema ontology-metamodel.schema.json --def change_line --file <line>). Nouns are the vocabulary objects of EE-107 item 7, and the change line is EE-107 items 1 and 2. Changing this file is a one-way-door amend. mappings names the SKOS and OWL term for each class and noun field, or none.

check.note: the paths the retired-noun scan reads

nouns.note: each noun is in this scheme

standard.note: free text naming the established usage, not a link to another scheme

status.note: owl:deprecated is true when status is retired

function.note: the owning department id, or null for a shared word

term.note: an admitted EE-095 term in schema/terms/admitted.json

shape.note: sh:NodeShape in SHACL, as EE-107 item 7 describes

bfo.note: rdfs:subClassOf the named BFO class in OWL documents

verb.note: a change verb classifies a change to the vocabulary, which SKOS and OWL do not model

change_line.note: a proposed change to the vocabulary, not a term in it

check.description: Files and folders schema/check-nouns.mjs scans for retired nouns.

top_category.description: A top category of the upper ontology (N-049, EE-113), mapped to the class of BFO (ISO/IEC 21838-2) it falls under. That every noun reaches exactly one top category through broader is checked through the EE-095 term engine (term top-category, node schema/terms/upper-test.ts), not here.

noun.description: A noun, the vocabulary object of class noun (EE-107 item 7). schema/ontology-gate.ts checks what needs other files: functions are departments, capabilities are owned, a term is admitted.
The name, with no leading or trailing whitespace. A scoped sense is name@function.

standard.description: The established usage the noun follows, ours when coined, or none.

function.description: The owning department id, or null when the word is shared.

handoff_type.description: True when the noun can type a handoff package.

capabilities.description: For a function noun, the nouns it owns.

required_touches.description: Department ids a handoff of this type must touch.

term.description: The admitted EE-095 term this noun names.

properties.description: Property ids of the term that a handoff of this type must satisfy.

retired_pattern.description: A regular expression for the retired noun, which schema/check-nouns.mjs fails on.

shape.description: A JSON Schema of what a record claiming this noun must contain (EE-107 item 7).

broader.description: What the noun is a kind of: other nouns or top categories (N-049).

verb.description: One of exactly three change verbs (EE-107 item 1).

kind.description: A change kind. create: originate, derive. amend: append, rename, deprecate, revise. delete: remove, merge (EE-107 item 1).

tier.description: The maximum of four scores, severity, reversibility, time to detect and blast radius (EE-107 item 2).

change_line.description: One proposed change: one verb, one kind of that verb, one noun and a tier. derive names its source and merge names its successor. A compound change is split into separate lines.

source.description: For derive, the noun the new one came from.

successor.description: For merge, the noun that remains.
